title: 2 Person Mini Power Boat Rental at Tampa Riverwalk
includes: All Safety equipment including life jacket
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Infants can't sit on driver's lap. Infants are considered a person and count towards the capacity limit of the boat.
Driver must be at least 18 years of age
Weight Limit of 316lbs per boat total
policies: Driver must have government issued ID, such as Driver's license
Driver must bring a credit card to hold in case of damages (can't say debit on it)
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Hop aboard your own personal Mini-Powerboat with seating for 2! From there, you are free to explore Tampa's waterways how ever you wish. Want to go North on the winding Hillsborough river? Go for it! Care for a quick trip along Bayshore Blvd or Davis Islands, getting a glimpse at some of the most impressive houses in Tampa? Don't let us stop you! Or maybe the open waters of Hillsborough Bay are more your style, with the wind in your hair while dolphin watching. Either way, you can choose your own path and the sites you want to see!
